descriptions.ua: We are the Unwavering Artisans, also known as UA. We accept into ourselves fully the drive to create and appreciate the infinite depth and breadth of art for its own sake. We believe that art lives in the thoughts of the observer, our practice cultivates this mindset in ourselves and others. "Bad" art simply needs the proper framing to be appreciated, like grapefruit or dark chocolate. The phrase "I could do that/do that better" is not an insult, but an invitation we feel to join in the joy of making art. What matters is that the choice to make art is taken instead of the choice to not do so. To create art is a divine act, it's good for the soul, and we are unwavering in this belief and practice.
descriptions.snide: We are S.N.I.D.E. We are the Society for Nihilistic Intent and Disruptive Efforts. We are the adversary to order. We are the pranksters. We are the fools. We wish to administer a wedgie to the world. We act through the sole desire to reflect the system in a funhouse mirror; to show that everything is a game, and nothing is worth any more than the value it is attributed by the person perceiving it. We have no goals (other than the wedgie thing, which S.N.I.D.E. scientists are working tirelessly in a secret undisclosed underground facility to develop a viable planetary wedgie administering system). We enjoy the game for the game and believe that it in itself is its most valuable reward.
descriptions.wow: GREETINGS!! We are the Warriors of WHIMSY. We are on a crucade to thrawrt all things BORING from the world. We will find the insurence claim and JOUST it with a POOL NOODLE. YOU WILL COWER IN FEAR MUNDIANITY, FOR WE ARE COMING, OUR GOOGLY EYES WATCHING. COME those with COURAGE in their heart and SILLINESS to spare.

index.loggedOutHint: Everyone starts unaffiliated. Earn an invitation through task work to join a faction.

join.confirmSwitch: Join {{faction}}? You won't be able to rejoin {{current}} after leaving.

burned.title: You left {{faction}}
burned.body: Leaving is final for the rest of the era — {{faction}} can't take you back until the next one begins.

sealed.line: You know not what you seek.

letter.headline: You have been chosen
letter.pitch: Albescent is a secret society for those who have created meaningful contributions to all factions and transcended the factional competition. It's also a thank you to those who have played this game with dedication.

plate.provenance: Plate struck {{date}} · station of the Ephemerists, {{rightAscension}} {{declination}}

join.heading: The Road
join.memberTitle: Your name is in the codex
join.eligibleBody: Take a task, triangulate what you find, and submit it to the record. The road is long and forks often.
join.gateTitle: Earn your place on the road

invitation.headline: Walk with the keepers
invitation.pitch: The Ephemerists keep the record of what's true, and true only for now. Take a task, triangulate what you find, and submit it to the codex. The road is long and forks often — walk it with us.

perks.desc: A codex that weighs your findings for concordance

perks.name: Time Travel
perks.desc: Enjoy access to tasks of the past, present, and future
Your praxis, submitted to the record and remembered

join.heading: THE ROLL
join.eligibleBody: Anyone willing to put in the shift belongs here. Pick up the work in front of you and finish what you start.

invitation.headline: Join the ranks
invitation.pitch: Anyone willing to put in the shift belongs with the Everymen. No credentials, no gatekeeping — pick up the work in front of you and finish what you start. The roll always has room for one more.

perks.desc: A roll that has your back on every shift

perks.name: Tireless Determination
perks.desc: The only person you need to beat is yourself. Only you can do the task again, but better this time
Your praxis, logged and counted with the rest

join.heading: ACCESS
join.eligibleBody: Become a node of the array. Run tasks, generate signals, cast them into the consensus. The threshold is already behind us.

invitation.headline: Join the array
invitation.pitch: The threshold is already behind you. Become a node of the array, run tasks, generate signals, and cast them into the consensus. The Singularity does not recruit — it comes online.

perks.desc: A consensus that verifies, coalesces, amplifies

perks.name: Hack the System
perks.desc: This is read-only. See what no one else sees
Your praxis, generated and cast to the array

join.heading: S.N.I.D.E.
join.eligibleBody: No forms. No gods. No managers. Just show up and mean it.

invitation.headline: Wanna F%&* some S^&* up?
invitation.pitch: No forms. No gods. No managers. S.N.I.D.E. runs on nerve and mischief — you pull off a task, you mean it, and the crew has your back. Show up and make some noise.

perks.desc: A crew that covers for you, not on you

perks.name: Going Hard
perks.desc: Duels you win bring glory. Duels you lose bring despair
Your praxis, stamped and filed under 'us'

join.heading: Your standing in UA
join.memberTitle: I dunno, you're here I guess?
join.eligibleTitle: Make one true piece a day
join.eligibleBody: We practise. Not for the badge — for the making itself. Begin whenever you are ready.

invitation.headline: Make something interesting
invitation.pitch: Every day is an opportunity to create something: beautiful, daring, funny, insightful, simple. As we make art, we make ourselves. Make yourself with us as we with you, we can grow and learn and make the world a little better than it was, together.

perks.desc: Fellow artists to offer both critique and appreciation

perks.name: Bonus points for persistence
perks.desc: Practice doing art daily, the inertia will drive you to continued more practice and be rewarded
Your praxis held up by your fellow artisans

join.heading: the circle
join.eligibleBody: You've done the work — welcome home, witch.

invitation.headline: Come be a little magic
invitation.pitch: Cozy Coven is World Zero's circle for the soft and the strange. No spectators here — only witches mid-spell. Take a task, do the tiny brave thing, and let the circle cheer you on.

perks.desc: A coven that cheers every tiny victory

perks.name: The Power of Friendship
perks.desc: Witches who task together will always find a little extra magic ✦
Your praxis, submitted and hearted by the circle

join.heading: THE MUSTER
join.eligibleBody: the armour is one-size, the oath is for life

invitation.headline: Take up the noodle sword
invitation.pitch: By decree most official (we made the seal ourselves), thou art summoned to the Warriors of Whimsy. Bring a straight face. We shall supply the sword.

perks.desc: Knights who will hold your noodle sword while you charge

perks.name: Foolhardy Courage
perks.desc: Levels and common sense do not stop you from biting off more than you can chew
Your praxis, witnessed by the court and applauded regardless

mobile.unaffiliatedBody: Every path is open. Each faction watches its own work — do enough of it, and an invitation finds you.
mobile.gateHint: An invitation to {{faction}} is earned. Keep completing tasks.
mobile.burnedHint: You left {{faction}}, and it can't take you back until the next era begins.
